trimmingSuggestions.description: The initial plugging in of the router and focus on the orange light could be trimmed, as it's implied by the later connection of the ethernet cable and green light.
The extended focus on the router label could be shortened. Showing the label briefly and then mentioning where to find the password would suffice.
While the explanation of finding the admin panel address is important, this segment could be more concisely presented with visual aids, perhaps with text overlays highlighting the address.
